title: Limit interest calculator to 1 year maximum using days input

requirements.summary: Replace the 'years' input field with a 'days' input field that accepts values from 1 to 365 days
acceptanceCriteria: Input accepts only integer values between 1 and 365
Validation error appears if user enters a value outside this range
Placeholder text shows example like '90' or '180'

file_operations.description: Replace the 'years' input field with a 'days' input field. Update the label from 'Years' to 'Days', change the input name and id attributes to 'days', set placeholder to '180', and update the min/max attributes to 1 and 365 respectively. Update state management to use 'days' instead of 'years'.

requirements.summary: Update the frontend interest calculation logic to convert days to a fraction of a year before performing the calculation
acceptanceCriteria: Results display correctly for any valid days input
Precision is maintained for partial year calculations

file_operations.description: Update the calculation logic to accept 'days' instead of 'years'. Convert days to a year fraction by dividing by 365 (days/365), then apply the existing formula: principal × 9 × (days/365). Ensure precision is maintained for partial year calculations by keeping decimal values.

requirements.summary: Update the results display to show the number of days used in the calculation alongside the principal, interest, and total
acceptanceCriteria: Days value matches the user's input
Display formatting is consistent with existing result fields

file_operations.description: Add a new field to display the number of days used in the calculation. Add 'Days: [number]' before or after the principal amount display, using the same layout pattern and styling as existing result fields (icon + label + value). Ensure the days value is passed through props and displayed consistently with the existing currency formatting style.
Update the return type to include the 'days' value alongside principal, interest, and total. This allows the ResultsDisplay component to show the days used in the calculation.

requirements.summary: Update the validation utility to replace year validation with days validation
acceptanceCriteria: validateInput.ts checks for days range instead of years
Minimum value is 1 day, maximum is 365 days

file_operations.description: Replace the year validation function with a days validation function. Update the function name from validateYears (or similar) to validateDays. Change the validation range from 0-30 years to 1-365 days. Update error messages to reference 'days' instead of 'years', such as 'Please enter a valid number of days between 1 and 365'.
Update the form validation to call the new validateDays function instead of the year validation function. Ensure validation error messages display correctly for the days input field.
